name: Mistral Medium 3.5 128B

lineage.how_derived: merged flagship: replaces Mistral Medium 3.1 and Magistral in Le Chat and Devstral 2 in the Vibe coding agent

purpose: Mistral's first 'flagship merged model': one dense 128B set of weights that handles instruction following, reasoning and coding, with reasoning effort configurable per request and a vision encoder trained from scratch for variable image sizes (card).

license.name: Modified MIT License (Mistral AI, 2026)
license.notes: LICENSE file read. MIT grant to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense and sell, with attribution, but 'You are not authorized to exercise any rights under this license if the global consolidated monthly revenue of your company (or that of your employer) exceeds $20 million (or its equivalent in another currency) for the preceding month'; the restriction covers derivatives and combined works, and a commercial license can be requested from Mistral at its sole discretion. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: dense transformer with vision encoder (Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration, ministral3 text config)
architecture.attention: GQA, 96 heads and 8 KV heads, head dim 128, full attention (no sliding window), YaRN rope factor 64
architecture.why_this_design: Card: merge instruct, reasoning and coding into a single model so that one set of weights serves quick chat replies and long agentic runs, with the reasoning effort ('none' or 'high') chosen per request.

variants.format: safetensors (FP8 static activation quantization per config.json)
variants.notes: card warns that an incorrect Transformers config entry degraded long-context quality until the fix of 2026-05-01; GGUFs made from the old config are affected
10,839 downloads, created 2026-04-27; bartowski and mradermacher GGUFs also exist; sizes not collected

pc-24gb.notes: about 72 GB at 4 bit must stream from RAM on every token (dense, no sparsity), far below usable decode speed

pc-32gb.notes: fits 128 GB RAM plus VRAM but decode is bound by RAM bandwidth

mac-64gb-plus.notes: does not fit 64 GB at 4 bit

engine_support.notes: GGUFs from unsloth, bartowski and mradermacher exist; Mistral Vibe can use a local vLLM server.

strengths: Vendor says it supersedes Devstral on all its coding benchmarks and powers Le Chat
Native function calling and JSON output
weaknesses: 128B dense: no sparsity to exploit on a single consumer GPU
Other benchmark figures are images on the card

user_reports.summary: Maintainers flagged that GGUFs and quantized or fine-tuned models built before the Transformers config fix lose long-context quality; the card carries the same warning.

soft.maturity: Mistral AI flagship; active community quantization (NVFP4, AWQ, GGUF, MLX).

tona_fit.reason: Strongest Mistral model with good vendor coding numbers and 24 languages, but a dense 128B needs 96-128 GB unified memory to be usable. Re-check if a smaller Mistral Medium appears.

sources.note: model card read (first part), LICENSE and config.json read

open_questions: Benchmark figures on the card are images: MMLU-Pro, GPQA, AIME and similar
GGUF sizes and real decode rate on 96-128 GB machines
